@graph.name: Renegade Insurance
@graph.description: Get insurance quotes from 100 insurance companies while working with your local agent. The easiest way to buy and manage all of your insurance needs.

acceptedAnswer.text: Renegade Insurance is a modern P&C insurance company that helps agents own, sell, and manage insurance agencies. Renegade runs a franchise network, acquires agencies and books of business, and manages books for agents who keep ownership.

Renegade Insurance operates three core programs: agency franchising, agency acquisitions, and back office support. Renegade holds direct appointments with regional and national carriers and MGAs across personal lines, commercial lines, and specialty products.
Renegade Insurance is headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon. Renegade operates 9 retail locations across Florida, South Carolina, Georgia, and Texas.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Renegade franchise cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renegade franchise fees start at $20,000 depending on business type. A monthly support and technology fee applies after launch, and financing is available for qualified candidates.

mainEntity.name: How does Renegade value an agency it acquires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renegade builds a market-based valuation using retention ratio, commission revenue, growth trajectory, and book mix. Renegade acquires agencies with cash at close and no broker fees at any stage.

mainEntity.name: Is Renegade Insurance a good place to work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renegade Insurance is a Great Place to Work Certified company. Renegade’s team works across its Oregon headquarters, its retail locations, and its operations and technology partners.
